description: This Java class 'ProductConfigWorker' provides utility methods for managing product configuration data, including caching, loading, filling, and storing product configuration wrappers within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ProductConfigWorker
classes.description: Utility class for managing product configuration data, including caching, loading, filling, and storing configurations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cached ProductConfigWrapper for a given product, considering catalog, website, store, and currency context.

methods.name: fillProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Populates a ProductConfigWrapper with user input from an HttpServletRequest, including handling virtual components and feature trees.

methods.name: storeProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Stores the current product configuration into the database, updating or creating a configuration ID.

methods.name: loadProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Creates and loads a ProductConfigWrapper based on a given configuration ID, for use in product customization.
